Subject: Atelier Workshop — staffing, transport checkpoints, and session boundaries

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our follow-up notes, I wanted to share the initial operational plan for the two-day Atelier exec workshop (Sept 13–14) and surface a few decision points we need to finalize to lock travel and local staffing: 

1) Arrival windows & customs-friendly routing: we propose staggered arrival windows for Redwood staff and visiting customer execs to simplify badge pickup and customs support. Tentative windows: 09:00–11:00 and 14:00–16:00 on Sept 12.

2) Onsite checkpoints (boarding-pass ops): we need a dedicated check-in table for Redwood hosts + a separate table for visiting partners to minimize queueing. Can Atelier provide a dedicated 6x2 table and one radio for host-ops?

3) Transportation & shuttles: Hotel -> venue shuttle every 30 mins (07:30–09:30 / 16:30–19:00). Please confirm constraints on vehicle size (we expect groups of 6–12).

4) Session boundaries and staffing: We recommend two_session_roster turns per day to cover AM/PM rooms (3 hosts each). Ben (CC’d) will build the staffing rotation — he needs final attendee headcount by Aug 20.

Attachments: I’ll attach the working hotel block spreadsheet and draft agenda in my next message.

Ask: Can you confirm the venue’s access hours and whether security will allow early-bag drop on Sept 12? If yes, we’ll push the earliest arrival window earlier.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant

Subject: Re: Atelier Workshop — staffing, transport checkpoints, and session boundaries

Hi Michael —

Thanks — this looks good. A few quick notes from venue ops: 
- Access hours: venue doors open at 06:30 for vendors; main security desk lets us in from 07:00. Early bag drops are fine after 08:00 only (they need a manifest).
- Radio: we can allocate one radio to the Redwood host desk and run power outlets there.
- Vehicle sizes: the courtyard limits vehicles > 7m; shuttles must be standard 12–15 passenger vans.

Questions:
1) When you say 'two_session_roster turns', do you plan 3 hosts per room or 3 hosts rotating across rooms? We want to ensure we have the right headcount on-site.
2) Will Redwood need help with local customs letters for inbound staff with equipment?

Tom (venue ops) is looped for the manifest procedure and a sample manifest format — Tom, can you confirm the manifest fields we need?

Ava

--
Ava Mitchell
Head of Events, Atelier

Ava — perfect, thanks for the constraints. Quick answers:

1) Two_session_roster: Ben will staff rooms in fixed AM/PM shifts (three hosts per room each shift). Rationale: reduces handoff friction and keeps a single point-of-contact for each session.

2) Customs letters: Yes, we will provide standard equipment letters for staff traveling with demo units. Marissa (CC’d) will own getting them signed by legal and uploading to the shared Drive.

I’ve attached the hotel-blocks spreadsheet (columns: name, arrival, airline+flight, room type, special requests) — please use the column headers when submitting attendee lists. Also attaching the current agenda (workshop-agenda-v3.docx) for your scheduling team.
